texts.error.game_missing: The game's zip, %1, could not be opened.
texts.error.no_game: ScummVM found no game it knows in %1. Give the game's folder as a zip: the files the game was installed with, not an installer or a disc image.
texts.error.no_game_slot: The project has no game. A ScummVM project needs the game's folder, as a zip.
texts.error.no_memory: The core ran out of memory while starting.
texts.error.not_zip: %1 is not a zip file this core can read, or it is damaged.
texts.error.rom_missing: %1 is missing. The Music device setting asks for a Roland synthesizer, which needs its ROM files: give them as firmware, or choose another music device.
texts.error.scummvm: ScummVM could not run the game: %1
texts.error.zip_encrypted: %1 in the zip is protected by a password. Make the zip again without one.
texts.error.zip_method: %1 in the zip is compressed in a way this core cannot read. Make the zip again with ordinary (Deflate) compression or none.
texts.firmware.cm32l_control.about: The CM-32L's program ROM, version 1.02. ScummVM's CM-32L emulation needs it.
texts.firmware.cm32l_control.label: CM-32L control ROM (1.02)
texts.firmware.cm32l_pcm.about: The CM-32L's sound samples. ScummVM's CM-32L emulation needs them.
texts.firmware.cm32l_pcm.label: CM-32L PCM ROM
texts.firmware.mt32_control.about: The MT-32's program ROM, version 1.07. ScummVM's MT-32 emulation needs it.
texts.firmware.mt32_control.label: MT-32 control ROM (1.07)
texts.firmware.mt32_pcm.about: The MT-32's sound samples. ScummVM's MT-32 emulation needs them.
texts.firmware.mt32_pcm.label: MT-32 PCM ROM
texts.setting.musicdriver.about: The device ScummVM plays the game's music on, for games that can use more than one. The Roland devices are emulated and need their ROM files. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.oplemulator.about: Which emulation of the AdLib sound chip plays AdLib music and sound. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.subtitles.about: Show the spoken lines as text, in games that have both speech and text. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: The game's folder, as a zip: every file of the game, as ScummVM would use them from a folder. A zip holding one folder is that folder. ScummVM itself finds out which game it is.
texts.slot.savedata.help: ScummVM's saved games to start from, as one zip of the save files (what the core's save data export writes). They are in the machine's memory from the start.
